verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy is a payments and merchant-of-record platform, so marketplace payments are a fair question for it. The evidence documents only single-merchant selling: checkout, subscriptions, license keys and MoR tax handling. Nothing shows onboarding third-party sellers, splitting a payment between parties, or paying out to multiple sellers, and one community comment notes MoR isn't available for marketplaces.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller
